processes.name: Dealer Order Intake & Quoting
processes.description: Independent dealers request trailer configurations and pricing. The Dealer Account Coordinator processes requests using standard templates, while the Sales Manager approves quotes via an Excel pricing workbook. Dealers independently set final retail prices and handle customer purchases.
pain_points: Dealer-set retail prices complicate margin tracking

processes.name: Production Scheduling & Shop Floor Coordination
processes.description: A dedicated scheduler maintains a master Excel schedule and shop whiteboard, while the Plant Manager oversees daily floor operations. Paper work orders physically travel through fabrication stations. The process includes weekly setup planning and managing schedule changes or material shortages.
pain_points: Reliance on disconnected Excel sheets and paper work orders
Manual schedule updates during production changes
Tracking material shortages without integrated ERP

processes.name: Purchasing, Receiving & Inventory Management
processes.description: The Materials Manager and Buyer procure components using Excel lists. The Receiving Clerk logs deliveries via paper forms, updates a shared Excel stock sheet, and performs weekly physical counts. QuickBooks Desktop Enterprise is used strictly for supplier billing, not shop-floor inventory tracking.
pain_points: QuickBooks not integrated with operational stock data

processes.name: Manufacturing (Cutting, Welding, Assembly) & Quality Inspection
processes.description: The shop fabricates steel frames, welds components, applies exterior panels, wiring, and running gear, then paints units. A final inspection verifies each trailer against the specific model and dealer-ordered options before it leaves the facility.
pain_points: Manual tracking of work-in-progress across stations
Potential rework if dealer specs are misinterpreted

processes.name: Shipping, Invoicing & Dealer Delivery Coordination
processes.description: Completed trailers are shipped from the factory, with independent dealers arranging or accepting delivery by appointment. The Dealer Account Coordinator manages post-shipment invoicing and fields status inquiries from dealers.
pain_points: Coordinating delivery appointments across 80+ independent locations
Invoice timing misaligned with physical delivery

processes.name: Warranty Claims & Dealer Support
processes.description: Independent dealers report product issues, which are routed to a Quality and Warranty Lead. Claims are evaluated case-by-case without blanket policies; the lead validates issues and approves dealer repairs before work begins.
pain_points: Tracking repair status across multiple dealers
